address: ASH1 DC1: 22271 Broderick Drive, Sterling VA 20166
ASH1 DC2: 22280 Randolph Drive, Sterling VA 20166 (under construction)

reading.body:
QTS Ashburn 1 sits at 22271 Broderick Drive in Sterling, Virginia, with a second building at 22280 Randolph Drive listed as under construction at the time the spec page was read. The campus publishes 55 MW of IT capacity. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 55 MW is roughly 1,375 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a common colocation density, the same load supports roughly 5,500 racks. Those are assumptions about density, not claims by the operator. The second building means total capacity is not yet final, and the published figure of 55 MW may not reflect the completed campus.

The single published certification is LEED, which addresses the energy and environmental design of the building. LEED does not certify uptime tier or security posture. No Uptime Institute tier rating, SOC attestation, or federal compliance designation is published on the spec page this site read, so none can be assumed.

Virginia holds 326 mapped facilities in this site's dataset, of which only 19 publish a megawatt figure. Those 19 sum to 1,326 MW of published IT capacity. At 55 MW, QTS Ashburn 1 ranks fifth among that group, representing roughly 4 percent of the published Virginia total. Virginia's concentration of published capacity reflects the Ashburn corridor, and this campus is one of the larger single-operator figures in the state's published record, though most Virginia facilities publish no figure at all, so the true state total is larger by an unknown amount.
